# History: RHM (Random Hierarchy Model)

*Auto-generated big-picture history. See [README.md](README.md) for current state and [FILES.md](FILES.md) for the full file index.*

## Why RHM exists

The program's natural-language experiments (`experiments/language_reduction`) had hit an identifiability wall: vocab reduction turned out to be a channel intervention (moves β, not γ), and spectral denoising was entangled with the very statistics being measured. RHM was adopted specifically to buy back what language couldn't give — a generative process with a *known* ground truth, where DGP interventions (depth `L`, synonymy `m`) can be cleanly separated from channel interventions (vocab `v`). See [README.md](README.md)'s opening and `ideas/language_reduction.md`. Everything below is downstream of that one methodological move.

## Phase 1 — establishing phenomenology (06-20 → 06-23)

The scaling sweep found **synonymic multiplicity `m`, not depth `L`, is the scaling bottleneck** (quadrupling `m` cuts α by 34%; doubling `L` cuts it by only 12%) — [README.md §Scaling exponent sweep](README.md). The forward-model (FM) residual-rank instrument, used to ask whether the FM's leftover error reflects DGP complexity, produced its first read: rank tracks the *main model's* computation, not the FM's capacity. This instrument would later turn out to be measuring the wrong thing (Phase 6). A dedicated trajectory run then found the defining phenomenon of the whole program's early period, the **L-to-m transition** — a signature (rising feature η², non-monotone top-1 PC, cosine entering a "sweet spot") that fixed the default operating point (`L=6, m=4, v=8, s=2`, 6L/6H/192D) used almost everywhere downstream ([README.md §Regime transition](README.md), [experiments/rhm/CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)). Per-level loss decomposition explained the mechanism: learning is strictly bottom-up, and a fixed model plateaus at a **composition-depth ceiling** set by capacity. A run of objective-shape interventions (label smoothing, focal loss, confidence thresholding, FM-surprise-weighted NTP) then ruled out the natural alternative hypothesis — the ceiling is **not** an artifact of NTP's sharpness bias — while incidentally discovering that *gradient reallocation* (focal loss, FM-surprise weighting) buys better FM legibility at no compositional cost. That legibility lever becomes a recurring tool later in the program.

## Phase 2 — the ratchet arc: a negative result that redirects the program (06-23 → 06-29)

The MNIST "gated ratchet" (wake-sleep FM-inject/distill loop) compounds — the val-loss gap widens 34%→48% over 4 cycles. Nine experiments asked whether the same loop compounds on RHM's controlled DGP. **It does not**: every MNIST *dynamic* reproduces, but the *magnitude* never grows (~1% ceiling), after ruling out capacity, task structure, the distillation bottleneck, and FM-cosine regime in turn. The FOMAML diagnostic pinned the mechanism — on stationary data, no outer objective makes FM-predictability pressure improve compositional NTP, because "the outer loop is identical to the inner loop." See [ratchet/README.md](ratchet/README.md). This is the program's first major prior-correction: it establishes that **compounding self-improvement requires a moving frontier**, which stationary RHM cannot supply on its own. Everything from Phase 4 onward (specialization, minting, directed sculpting) is, in one way or another, an attempt to either manufacture that moving frontier or to find what *can* be gained without one.

## Phase 3 — self-knowledge pressure vs. weight decay, and a complexity-theoretic reading (07-01 → 07-07)

Co-training an FM and using its open-loop predictability as a regularizer beats weight decay's own functional-complexity floor (activation rank 42.9% vs WD's 52.6% floor, at preserved knowledge) — "L2-norm complexity ≠ functional complexity," made empirical. But the result is scoped immediately: **self-knowledge (loop closure) is not load-bearing for this** — the simplest open-loop pressure suffices ([README.md §FM-as-regularizer](README.md)). Reading the saved trajectories against Aaronson's "First Law of Complexodynamics" (rise-then-fall complexity under rising entropy) confirmed the rise-and-fall, with two amendments: the descent needs an annealer (SGD alone freezes mid-descent, "a glass, not a liquid"), and the floor is not zero but the **DGP's own sophistication relative to the observer's capacity bound** ([README.md §Complexodynamics](README.md)). This is the first point where RHM findings get explicitly read against an outside theoretical frame rather than just against MNIST/language priors.

## Phase 4 — specialization: the first sharp RHM-vs-language disanalogy (07-16 → 07-18)

Can the depth frontier be moved by *allocating* the objective rather than scaling the model? Breadth restriction is inert; level-reweighting is actively harmful; only a direct oracle deep target recruits depth at all — and even that target, concentrated onto a subtree, fails to specialize: broad training beats narrow on the target subtree itself, because **RHM's single shared ruleset has no domain-specific deep structure to specialize on** ([specialization/README.md](specialization/README.md)). Initially read as a limitation, this was reframed nine days later: "broad beats narrow" is the *enabling condition* for sample-efficient depth recovery via shared abstraction, not a deficiency — redirecting the open question from "give RHM domains" toward "what recruits level ℓ+1 once ℓ is consolidated." This line is still WIP, motivating an unbuilt heterogeneous-DGP variant.

## Phase 5 — confabulation, generation one: privilege attaches to manner, not content (07-22)

The standing objection to any introspection claim (Nisbett & Wilson) is that a self-report could reflect a learned self-*theory* rather than genuine access. The FM decomposition makes this operational: `FM(a_i)` is everything a self-theory could produce, so confabulation lives in its range and genuine access must live in the residual complement. The result: **IMPL is the only target with a first-person advantage over a capacity-matched third-party observer** — and closing the wake-sleep loop changes *how well* the model knows itself, not *what* there is to know (loop closure isn't necessary; residual DGP-structure is equal open- vs closed-loop) — [confabulation/README.md](confabulation/README.md). This finding — privileged access is about mechanism, not information content — becomes a belief the program keeps re-deriving (see Phase 10, Phase 11).

## Phase 6 — an instrument overhaul: residual rank was never measuring what it claimed (07-27)

A cross-domain audit (RHM + language + MNIST) falsified the belief `R_act ≈ R_comp + R_res` ([beliefs/dimensionality_expansion.md](../../beliefs/dimensionality_expansion.md)) and explained three separate historical "rank" negatives — including this program's own Phase-1 residual-rank experiment — as artifacts of a **saturated FM's noise floor**: where the FM drives residual toward zero, naive rank inflates regardless of what's actually happening. The old single scalar `R_res` is replaced with two decoupled instruments, **β** (residual shape) and **`R_res_participation`** (frontier dimensionality in the model's own basis) — [residual_decomposition/README.md](residual_decomposition/README.md). A follow-up pass ([residual_decomposition/trajectory/README.md](residual_decomposition/trajectory/README.md)) re-measured the Phase 3 complexodynamics trajectories with the new instrument: the rise-then-fall/arrest dissociation reproduces in 7/7 cells, but β itself **fails its own capacity-invariance check at every checkpoint** — two successive wrong self-diagnoses (a depth confound, then a gap-width confound) were built and disconfirmed before landing on "capacity-dependent, scope unknown." Absolute β values are now distrusted; only trajectory shapes are load-bearing. This phase sets the tone for the rest of the program's relationship to its own instruments — see Phase 8's "PR metric" correction and Phase 10's tracking self-audit.

## Phase 7 — directed sculpting: porting an outer-loop allocator, and a dense run of self-corrections (07-28 → 08-05)

The most structurally ambitious port in the program: mjc E3's `value = learning-progress × visits` allocator, moved onto RHM. The naive port is a confounded null by construction — RHM rule usage is uniform, so there's no relevance to allocate over — fixed with distractor channels, support-fixed drift, and a repair-cost instrument that itself required two rounds of self-correction (raw CE is *exactly* blind to the drift it was meant to detect; the first "repair gap" readout was confounded by ordinary continued training) — [directed_sculpting/README.md](directed_sculpting/README.md). The loop itself ([full_loop/README.md](directed_sculpting/full_loop/README.md)) then delivered the arc's most robust positive: a reward-free relevance signal separates real tokens from distractors 13–18× and recovers 76% of an oracle's allocation advantage. But both drift-dependent predictions the arc was built to test — hierarchy climbing and drift-sustained belief expansion — came back negative, reframed as **"expansion is a property of the grader's type, not of non-stationarity"** (a grounded evaluative grader expands the belief; an endogenous dense grader caps below the no-loop floor, in both static and drifting worlds). Nearly every child in this arc caught and corrected its own instrument mid-flight: two independently-built expansion experiments ([endo_expansion](directed_sculpting/full_loop/endo_expansion/README.md), [endogenous_expansion](directed_sculpting/full_loop/endogenous_expansion/README.md)) each discovered on their own that the parent's headline expansion metric was anti-informative; [metering_sweep](directed_sculpting/full_loop/metering_sweep/README.md)'s apparent "prize rises with data" reversed once compute was held fixed; and [level_moves](directed_sculpting/full_loop/level_moves/README.md)'s "value monotonically prefers depth" was corrected same-day to "gated by whether abstraction can reach the error." The density of self-caught confounds here is unusual even by this program's standards — almost nothing in this arc was trusted on a first read.

## Phase 8 — minting: a support oracle is not a density oracle (07-30)

Can a learner escape a narrow training slice by minting its own sequences and filtering them with a grader? The rule-table verifier (privileged, exact) beats every other filter, but only breaks even with *no* minting at all — real held-out data at the same volume still wins by 2.4×. The mechanism: **the grader answers "is this in-support," not "is this drawn with the right probability"** — and NTP training is density matching, so a support oracle can only delete bad mass, never add missing density information ([minting/README.md](minting/README.md)). A documented retraction sits inside this writeup: an earlier claim that one filtering arm "collapses to pure replay" was traced to overfitting on a memorizing pool, not to the mechanism claimed, and withdrawn on re-run.

## Phase 9 — endogenous teacher and cancellation: self-knowledge is directional, not scalar (08-04 → 08-05)

Gate 0 confirmed the model's own surprise is measurably distinct from the text's token surprisal (88.7% of FM-residual variance orthogonal to surprisal) and *anti*-localized — but using that residual as a **scalar** loss-reweighting signal is a clean, pre-registered null ([endogenous_teacher/README.md](endogenous_teacher/README.md)), consistent with two earlier "directional, not scalar" results from the language/vision program. The [cancellation](endogenous_teacher/cancellation/README.md) child rerouted the same residual through the computation itself (efference-copy subtraction) rather than reweighting a loss: the corollary-discharge mechanism **replicates a prior looped-ViT result to two decimal places** (`cos(Δ,inj)` +0.293→+0.088 vs the ViT's +0.89→+0.095) — a genuine cross-substrate confirmation — but the hoped-for downstream payoffs don't materialize; content matters, but *which* forecaster produced it doesn't.

## Phase 10 — conditional revision: from correlation to an exact oracle (08-07 → 08-10)

The program's most rigorous measurement to date: rather than correlating a residual with heuristic surprisal, this line computes belief revision **exactly via belief propagation** on RHM's latent structure — a hypertree, not a pairwise tree, a subtlety that itself required correcting an initial factorization that undercounted entropy ([conditional_revision/README.md](conditional_revision/README.md)). Verdict: belief revision is genuinely separable from surprisal, but **only at the shallow-to-mid levels where the model actually holds a belief** — the binding constraint is belief *depth*, not the conditioning gap per se. Its children largely converged on this being a well-explained but not exploitable phenomenon: [aleatoric_fraction](conditional_revision/aleatoric_fraction/README.md) shows there's almost no real headroom to exploit (NTP protects the floor); [sculpt_slip](conditional_revision/sculpt_slip/README.md) and [local_loss](conditional_revision/local_loss/README.md) each found a positive-then-null-then-killed arc when they tried to *train* on the signal, with local_loss also catching that ~90% of a previously trusted "legibility improving" readout was pure measurement gauge; [synonym_retention](conditional_revision/synonym_retention/README.md) found the exact discarding behavior an engineered loss was trying to induce already happens for free under plain NTP. The one clear positive is [rule_family](conditional_revision/rule_family/README.md), which challenges the line's static-reducibility premise by making rules vary in-context and gets the program's first strong in-context-learning result on RHM (0.645 of oracle ceiling). A tracking self-audit ([conditional_revision/README.md](conditional_revision/README.md), Appendix — applying a classic PET-imaging critique to their own difference-based readout) both certifies the finding where the gates fire and catches a subtle failure mode — two opposing errors canceling to fake agreement — precisely where the gates read null, tightening confidence in the result rather than undermining it.

## Phase 11 — temporal confabulation: the same conclusion, reached twice, now closed (08-10 → 08-11)

A direct sequel to Phase 5, now asking the introspection question on an *epistemically charged* residual (real belief-revision content, via the temporal axis conditional_revision opened up). Privileged self-access survives the axis change — but the private component of that privilege carries **zero** belief-revision content at every capacity tested; privilege attaches only to *manner of updating*, never to *what was learned from public evidence* ([confabulation/temporal/README.md](confabulation/temporal/README.md)). The [epistemics](confabulation/temporal/epistemics/README.md) child closed the remaining question — does the temporal FM do any concentrating work at all? — negatively: the raw update decodes belief-revision at least as well as the FM-subtracted residual. This closes the "private signal" and "concentration" questions on this axis and functions as the program's current consolidating belief: **depth-based and temporal introspection are the same access-limited-observer phenomenon**, and any future introspection-helps-X claim now has to clear the bar of beating an observer-simulated twin.

## Where this leaves the program

Three beliefs recur enough across independent lines to read as genuinely crystallized: (1) self-knowledge/introspection effects are **directional, not scalar** — re-derived in Phase 9 and Phase 10 independently; (2) privileged access is about **mechanism, not content** — re-derived in Phase 5 and Phase 11 a month apart, on different substrates; (3) **compounding requires a moving frontier**, established negatively in Phase 2 and never contradicted since — it is the implicit reason Phases 4, 7, and 8 all attempt, in different ways, to manufacture non-stationarity or allocation rather than just scale. Running underneath all of this is a second-order pattern worth naming on its own: this program distrusts its own instruments by default, and is usually right to — the residual-rank overhaul (Phase 6), the PR-metric and metering corrections (Phase 7), and the tracking self-audit (Phase 10) are not incidents, they are the modal outcome of building a new measurement here.
